objective: Create a governed open-source finance/quant/trading repository and dependency registry that records upstream health, license, intended project role, integration mode and adoption risk without selecting production dependencies.
scope: Verify Wave-1 open-source repositories using current upstream GitHub evidence
Record repository URL, upstream owner, license, activity timestamp and project role
Classify each candidate as ADOPT_CANDIDATE, USE_CANDIDATE, REFERENCE, REJECT or LICENSE_RISK
Separate direct dependency candidates from architecture/reference-only repositories
Record licensing, data-rights, maintenance and integration risks
Cross-link the canonical Technology & Provider Candidate Matrix
out_of_scope: Copy third-party source code into the repository
Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Every entry has an explicit classification and intended role
Every direct-use candidate has an explicit license assessment
No candidate is marked production approved
P01-B remains open and not falsely closed
evidence: Current GitHub repository metadata for Wave-1 candidates
Upstream license metadata and repository documentation
OpenBB organization wind-down notice current as of 2026-10-03
rollback: Revert registry artifacts and companion/state/catalog updates. No runtime code or production dependency is changed.
definition_of_done: License and maintenance risks are explicit
Technology & Provider Candidate Matrix links the registry
Task Catalog and Current State are reconciled
